cues: A workplace shower room makes an energetic commute practical for employees who change into office clothes on arrival.
Motorists are encouraged to leave extra room when passing helmeted commuters on narrow neighborhood streets.
An adult skills class practices balance in an empty lot before students try quiet neighborhood streets.
A guided vineyard outing links tasting rooms along quiet lanes, letting visitors explore without hiring a car.
A neighborhood nonprofit refurbishes donated frames, making affordable local transportation available to people seeking work.
An employer reimburses staff for routine journeys made without a car, freeing parking spaces for visitors.
